blurb: Seascape Golf Club offers an 18-hole, 6,034-yard par 71 golf course near the Pacific Ocean with manicured fairways and challenging greens. They provide private and group golf lessons and coaching programs for all skill levels, including beginner and junior programs. The club also hosts private events, weddings, corporate outings, and fundraisers with banquet facilities and catering services.
extraNote: Twilight times are seasonal and subject to change · Practice range may close due to wet conditions
